title: Dynamic Inventory, Safety Stock & Reorder Point Tracker
summary: Dynamic stock replenishment model calculating automated reorder thresholds and suggested batch sizes based on daily sales velocity, supplier lead times, and safety stock buffers.
problem: Online retailers face costly stockouts and overstock holding costs due to manual inventory estimation that fails to account for fluctuating lead times and sales velocity.
whatIDid: Structured inventory tracking modeling stock on hand, average daily sales velocity, supplier lead times (days), safety stock buffers, and unit wholesale costs.
Formulated a dynamic reorder point formula (=ROUND(Daily_Sales * Lead_Time + Safety_Stock, 0)) to automatically determine the exact threshold when replenishment must trigger.
Engineered suggested order quantity logic (=MAX(0, ROUNDUP(Reorder_Point - Stock_On_Hand + Daily_Sales * 14, 0))) to forecast a 14-day operational supply buffer.
Implemented high-visibility soft-alert badges (REORDER vs In Stock) and calculated total inventory capital at risk to support proactive supplier negotiations.
result: Established an automated replenishment framework providing continuous visibility into inventory health and mitigating stockout risk through formula-driven order alerts.
